\n

We read the transcription against a scan of the 1894 Scribner printing (New York) at the Internet Archive, with the 1885 Cassell printing (London) where a page needed a second witness, and corrected some forty places where a wrong word had crept in, among them a few of the pirates’ own turns of speech.

column2: Not a word of Stevenson’s has changed.
column3: It is also read against the 1894 Scribner printing, which puts right some forty words that had gone wrong in transcription; the Sources and Acknowledgements say more.
